title: add-observability-name-attribute
request: Can we make the observe and observe_debug decorators attach the span name (or function name) as an attribute on the wrapped function for easier introspection? I'd like the decorated function to have a __observability_name__ attribute set to the provided name or fallback to the original function name.
reference_diff:
--- a/browser_use/observability.py
+++ b/browser_use/observability.py
@@ -125,10 +125,18 @@
 
 	if _LMNR_AVAILABLE and _lmnr_observe:
 		# Use the real lmnr observe decorator
-		return cast(Callable[[F], F], _lmnr_observe(**kwargs))
+		real_decorator = cast(Callable[[F], F], _lmnr_observe(**kwargs))
 	else:
 		# Use no-op decorator
-		return _create_no_op_decorator(**kwargs)
+		real_decorator = _create_no_op_decorator(**kwargs)
+
+	def _wrapper(func: F) -> F:
+		wrapped = real_decorator(func)
+		# Attach the observability name for introspection; fall back to function name if not provided
+		setattr(wrapped, "__observability_name__", name or func.__name__)
+		return wrapped  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+	return _wrapper

 		# Use no-op decorator (either not in debug mode or lmnr not available)

+		wrapped = real_decorator(func)
+		# Attach the observability name for introspection; fall back to function name if not provided
+		setattr(wrapped, "__observability_name__", name or func.__name__)
+		return wrapped  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+	return _wrapper

+import pytest
+from browser_use.observability import observe, observe_debug
+
+def test_observe_decorator_sets_name():
+    @observe(name="myspan")
+    def foo():
+        return 42
+    assert getattr(foo, "__observability_name__", None) == "myspan"
+
+def test_observe_decorator_defaults_to_func_name():
+    @observe()
+    def bar():
+        return 1
+    assert getattr(bar, "__observability_name__", None) == "bar"
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_observe_debug_async_attribute():
+    @observe_debug(name="async_span")
+    async def async_func():
+        return "done"
+    assert getattr(async_func, "__observability_name__", None) == "async_span"
